item.title: [AI & I by Every] GitHub’s COO Explains Why AI Hasn’t Replaced Developers
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:36 Hi, I'm Mike Taylor. I'm the head of tech consulting at Every, and I sat down with Kyle Daigle, the COO of GitHub, and talked to him about what is happening on the front lines of coding agents. We have 17,000,000 poll requests coming in every month to GitHub now, it's growing exponentially and that puts them at the forefront of what's happening in this new economy. We talked about how that affects their users as well as how this affects open source maintainers and we co...
